videos.caption: China's Qwen 4 is finally here. Alibaba just launched Qwen4-Max, its new flagship AI model, at $1.50 per million input tokens and $4.50 output, compared with $4 and $20 for Claude Opus 5.5. Alibaba says it uses half the tokens of its last model and cuts the cost per task by 62%. But on its own chart, it only wins four of 16 tests, while Claude Opus 5.5 wins seven, and the chart skips Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon. It's not open source either, though smaller Qwen4 models will be later. Would you switch to a cheaper model that's almost as good?
